verdict.rationale: Better Auth's own openAPI() plugin serves a Scalar-rendered interactive reference at /api/auth/reference, where users can run endpoints with a "Try it out" button. The caveats are real: it only runs on the integrator's own deployment, there is no vendor-hosted console (the vendor OpenAPI paths probed 404), and the plugin is marked early-stage. Missing for 10: a public vendor-hosted interactive reference, a stable non-experimental plugin, and independent hands-on corroboration of the runnable examples.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: You can test the endpoints by clicking on the `Try it out` button and providing the required parameters.
Better Auth's openAPI() plugin generates an OpenAPI 3.1.1 schema covering core and plugin endpoints
